observation: Retained synthetic negative result: location bias dominates; direct memory correction helps slightly.
hypotheses: Training-target units reduce excessive location gradients and initial scale mismatch.
Residuals from a selected frozen base on a later purged holdout avoid mixed evolving/dropout references.
Validation selection of the deployed correction and scale by Student-t NLL aligns the controller objective with evaluation.

model_contract.standardized_head: c=mean(y_train), u=max(std(y_train, ddof=0), physical_scale_floor). mu=c+u*a; scale=u*softplus(b)+physical_scale_floor; df=2.1+softplus(d). Initialize a=0, scale=u*sqrt(3/5)+floor, df=5. Statistics never use validation or evaluation targets; horizon target is already aggregated so no extra horizon multiplier.
model_contract.unchanged_backbone: Existing temporal encoder, fixed reservoir, causal spectral descriptor and JEPA. Legacy defaults and old checkpoints remain supported.
model_contract.frozen_base: Partition outer training by unique decision dates at floor(0.6*N) and floor(0.8*N); purge labels at each next partition start. Fit on first part; select checkpoint on second part; freeze weights, scaler, target statistics, descriptors. Build residual memory only on third part with eval-mode forecasts after the full fitted cutoff.
model_contract.memory: Use existing same-asset fixed-key nearest-neighbor retrieval, FIFO retention, capacity128/neighbors4; utility/controller disabled for this successor. Replay heldout residuals chronologically with strict label maturity. Do not refit base after memory creation. Keep fixed during validation/evaluation.
model_contract.calibration: Grid memory weights [0,.25,.5,1] and scale multipliers [.5,.75,1,1.5,2]. Minimize equal-date/equal-asset validation Student-t NLL; ties select smallest correction, then scale nearest1. Separately select scale-only no-memory comparator on same checkpoint, same validation and same scale grid. No evaluation-derived choices.
model_contract.inference: mu=base_mu+w*retrieved_residual; scale=q*base_scale; retain base df. All observations must follow calibration label cutoff; labels and future_x not used for predictions.
model_contract.falsifier: If frozen residual fails to improve NLL over its same-checkpoint calibrated control, memory benefit is unsupported. If standardized trajectories remain biased or do not improve on fresh development data, scaling hypothesis is unsupported.
model_contract.complexity: Backbone unchanged. Residual construction/prediction O(N*C*D) brute-force memory retrieval with bounded C=128, key dimension D. Calibration 20 linear passes over validation rows.
risks: Pooled target statistics can miss asset heterogeneity.
Smaller base training sample can reduce skill.
Short validation may overfit the 20-candidate calibration grid.
FIFO may discard useful recurrence and freezing may miss regime changes.
Prior-art components do not establish novelty or SOTA.

evaluation_contract.data: Existing public_equity_crises_v1, same previously declared 24 present-day listings, hash verified, pre2025 only. Exploratory survivor sample with retrospective adjustments and research-coordinate timing.
evaluation_contract.fold: great_recession (2007-12 through 2009-06), predeclared for economic relevance before new fits; no outcomes viewed for selection.
evaluation_contract.stopping: One fixed matrix; all failures retained, no metric-driven retry or favorable seed deletion. No protected outcomes. No significance or SOTA claim from this short exploratory matrix.
evaluation_contract.fairness: All methods share outer information boundary; frozen pair shares exact base weights and residual-holdout allocation. Other methods use more base-fitting rows. Calibration/search counts and actual compute reported; no matched-search or efficiency claim.

prior_art_review.boundary: Normalization and strong simple linear forecasters are established. This is an engineering successor testing diagnosed defects, not a novel normalization claim. Local patch Transformer is explicitly not the original PatchTST recipe; original SOTA reproduction remains necessary.
